definitions.explanation: Describes someone who takes social obligations, debts of gratitude, and interpersonal duties seriously and always reciprocates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{義理堅|ぎりがた}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{義理堅|ぎりがた}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦お{返|かえ}し→お返し：08354_okaeshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Being dutiful, she always returns favors.

examples.japanese: {義理堅|ぎりがた}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恩師|おんし}→恩師：12598_onshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Being faithful to obligations, he sends New Year's cards every year even to his old teachers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧ (social obligation, duty) + ⟦{堅|かた}い→堅い：18753_katai⟧ (firm, strict). Describes someone who reliably fulfills social obligations and reciprocates kindness. This is generally a positive trait in Japanese culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {義理堅|ぎりがた}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a dutiful person
- {義理堅|ぎりがた}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ — a dutiful personality
- {義理堅|ぎりがた}く⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧ — to faithfully maintain a relationship

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese culture, ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧ (social obligation) is a fundamental concept governing interpersonal relationships. Being {義理堅|ぎりがた}い is considered admirable — it means one does not forget debts of gratitude and always reciprocates appropriately, whether through return gifts, favors, or maintaining relationships.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{律儀|りちぎ}→律儀：10908_richigi⟧ — conscientious, faithful (broader, includes general conscientiousness)
- ⟦{誠実|せいじつ}→誠実：14211_seijitsu⟧ — sincere, honest (focuses on honesty rather than obligation)
